prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game art for 妖怪夜市. Reference image 1 is the ONLY rendering/style target: matte DRY GOUACHE / Chinese ink brush, visible textured dry strokes, aged wood/bronze/paper/stone, warm amber lamp edges and desaturated blue shadows. Reference image 2 is a diagnostic catalog: use ONLY the named base character's identity and proportions, DO NOT reproduce its glossy CG lighting. Create THREE new capstone forms of that same little yokai in ONE TRANSPARENT RGBA atlas: exact three columns, one row, landscape 1536x1024 preferred. Leave a wide FULLY TRANSPARENT vertical strip between the three complete figures. All three figures face RIGHT in 3/4 game view, in a stable idle stance, equal body scale, never overlap. Each occupies at most 70% of its column width and 65% of canvas height, base at 82% of canvas height. No label, typography, watermark, grid line, environment, painted background or floor shadow. Modest stylization with bold readable silhouettes at 100px game size. No photorealistic fur, no plastic CGI, no saturated neon, no bright rim glow, no photoreal miniature product photography. Preserve the base species/object body, facial placement, feet and scale in all three forms. Character name 红灯笼 (lantern), identified by the matching base-column caption in reference image 2. Identity: round red anthropomorphic Chinese paper lantern, short wooden legs, red tassel, mellow golden inner light. Left, center, right forms respectively: 灯会: three little lantern attendants attached to a broad festival canopy, the MAIN round lantern face remains visible; 火树: bronze lamp lid with three restrained flames and one forward wick; 满街红火: red woven paper lattice around the same round lantern and two hanging warm lantern beads
